chapters.title: One tool is missing
chapters.say: I could not make your video yet. One tool is missing, and here is the fix.

scenes.heading: Install ffmpeg, then ask again
scenes.sub: ffmpeg turns the frames I draw into a video file.

beats.say: The missing tool is ffmpeg. It turns the frames I draw into a video file.
beats.speak: The missing tool is eff eff em peg. It turns the frames I draw into a video file.

beats.say: On a Mac, install it with Homebrew.
On Linux, use your package manager.
Then ask me again, and you will get your video.
